Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From e2bb9fab08cbcc7922050c7eb0bd650807abfa4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kan Liang <kan.liang@linux.intel.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2021 08:32:38 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] perf/x86/intel/uncore: Fix invalid unit check

The uncore unit with the type ID 0 and the unit ID 0 is missed.

The table3 of the uncore unit maybe 0. The
uncore_discovery_invalid_unit() mistakenly treated it as an invalid
value.

Remove the !unit.table3 check.

Fixes: edae1f06c2cd ("perf/x86/intel/uncore: Parse uncore discovery tables")
Signed-off-by: Kan Liang <kan.liang@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Peter Zijlstra (Intel) <peterz@infradead.org>
Reviewed-by: Andi Kleen <ak@linux.intel.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/1629991963-102621-3-git-send-email-kan.liang@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/arch/x86/events/intel/uncore_discovery.h b/arch/x86/events/intel/uncore_discovery.h
index 7280c8a3c831..6d735611c281 100644
--- a/arch/x86/events/intel/uncore_discovery.h
+++ b/arch/x86/events/intel/uncore_discovery.h
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@
 
 
 #define uncore_discovery_invalid_unit(unit)			\
-	(!unit.table1 || !unit.ctl || !unit.table3 ||	\
+	(!unit.table1 || !unit.ctl || \
 	 unit.table1 == -1ULL || unit.ctl == -1ULL ||	\
 	 unit.table3 == -1ULL)
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/x86/events/intel/uncore_discovery.h`**
   - The macro `uncore_discovery_invalid_unit(unit)` was modified by removing the check for `!unit.table3`. 
   - The updated macro now only checks for `!unit.table1`, `!unit.ctl`, and the conditions where `unit.table1`, `unit.ctl`, or `unit.table3` are equal to `-1ULL`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a bug where the uncore unit with type ID 0 and unit ID 0 was incorrectly treated as invalid due to the check on `unit.table3`. By removing this check, the patch ensures that valid uncore units are correctly recognized, thus fixing the issue introduced in a previous commit (edae1f06c2cd). This change enhances the accuracy of the unit validation logic in the uncore discovery process.
